correctness.rationale: The explicit isoptic equation and polar Jacobian prove the simple Jordan curve; its curvature is exactly r²+64e²−20re cos3t. A global one-variable maximum yields three supporting chords; monotone curvature on retained arcs proves these and only these constitute the convex hull. Green’s formula and uniform Taylor analysis give an exact integral and the positive coefficient. High-precision checks confirm but are not used as an infinite proof.

originality.rationale: The claim is the exact global convex-hull chord configuration and a new quantitative nonanalytic area defect for a classical harmonic orthoptic. The 2003 area-angle theorem and 2021 curvature transition for the same support family do not give the convexification area. Full accessible primary text and indexed-record semantic comparisons were examined; no dominating result identified, with historical-priority risk explicitly retained.
residual_risks: Historical convex-hull formulas for threefold epitrochoids could contain an equivalent specialization without isoptic terminology; full priority certification is not possible from indexed searches.
The 2003 and 2021 same-support precedents make the curvature transition non-original; only the exact global hull and area asymptotics are claimed.
Same-model proof review and finite diagnostics do not replace independent specialist validation.
